clue.text: Mating without spirit leads to minimal exchange of letters in spirit as spiritual exercise

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the word for mating sits around the spirit

parts.note: sex is mating
an elf is a fairy spirit

indicators.note: the smallest possible swap of letters: two of them trade places in the word for spirit

parts.note: animation is spirit, liveliness

explanation.surface: A tortuous recipe for a religious discipline involving abstinence and wordplay on spirit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside. 'minimal exchange of letters in' trades just two letters of the spirit word, the N and the M.
explanation.definitionFit: Searching one's own conscience is a classic religious discipline of devotion.

clue.text: Educationalist, misguided 'n' boring, passes on to those in charge of 6 etc

parts.note: Michael Gove was the UK Education Secretary when this puzzle appeared

indicators.note: misguided letters go astray, so they are rearranged

parts.note: to pass on is to die, so dies

explanation.surface: A satirical swipe at an education minister's dull, wrong-headed briefing to school managers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misguided' rearranges N and BORING into RNINGBO. Michael Gove was the British Education Secretary, a target of teachers' complaints.
explanation.definitionFit: A school such as the one at 6 is run by a board of governors, its governing body.

clue.text: Learns adjustment on road, politician being light on headgear

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written MI

indicators.note: an adjustment rearranges, so these letters are reordered

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Someone learning to adapt on the road while a politician wears a lamp on his helmet.
explanation.walkthrough: M1, written MI, is Britain's main motorway; 'adjustment' rearranges the six letters of Learns.
explanation.definitionFit: A mining lamp is the lamp clipped to a pitman's helmet underground.

clue.text: Holy man has degrees encompassing headgear

indicators.note: encompassing means surrounding, so the degrees go round the headgear

parts.note: two MAs, Master of Arts degrees
a hat is headgear

explanation.surface: A holy man with a couple of degrees and a hat between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Mahatma is an Indian title for a great-souled sage, as for Gandhi.

clue.text: See the point?

definitions.meaning: to see is to notice or pick out
a point is a dot or a particular place

explanation.definitionFit: To spot is to see, and a spot is a point, dot or place.

clue.text: Little Christian and his log twice produced by ladies' seminary

indicators.note: produced in the sense of worked up into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: Chr. is the short form of Christian

indicators.note: twice means the words his log are written two times over

parts.note: taken as written, his log

explanation.surface: A man called Christian and his diary entries, twice over, come out of a girls' school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twice' gives HISLOGHISLOG; with CHR, 'produced' rearranges the fifteen letters into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A seminary is an old word for a school, and a girls' high school is one for young ladies.

clue.text: Through and through rather than by 6 etc?

definitions.meaning: educated by a comprehensive school rather than by a selective school like the one at 6

explanation.definitionFit: Comprehensively means thoroughly, and punningly the way of a comprehensive school.

clue.text: Priest with no right to entertain the Queen taking on little blue flower girl

indicators.note: to entertain guests is to hold them within, so these pieces go inside
with no means lacking, so a letter is removed

parts.note: a vicar is a parish priest
ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A clergyman hosts the monarch and takes on a girl as a flower seller.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no' drops the R, and 'to entertain' puts the royal cipher and ON inside what remains; the definition does double duty as flower and girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Veronica, or speedwell, is a small blue wildflower, and it is also a girl's name.

clue.text: Nasty stuff first accepted by flower boy

indicators.note: accepted by means taken in, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, a river; the Po is Italy's longest
a son is a boy
I is the Roman numeral one, first

explanation.surface: A flower-boy is the first to receive something nasty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' here is a thing that flows, the river Po.
explanation.definitionFit: Toxic substances are about the nastiest stuff there is.

clue.text: Left centre gala to degenerate

indicators.note: the centre of a word is its middle letters

parts.note: a fete is a gala or fair

explanation.surface: A left-wing centre's gala descends into decadence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centre' takes the middle letters of LEFT, EF.
explanation.definitionFit: Effete means feeble and decadent, worn out like something degenerate.

clue.text: Buck — if it does, it won't be with grasshopper

definitions.meaning: a buck is a male deer or similar beast

definitions.text: if it does, it won't be with grasshopper
definitions.meaning: if the ant of the fable elopes, runs away to marry, it leaves the grasshopper

explanation.definitionFit: A buck is the male of an antelope, and split up the word reads ant elope.

clue.text: More than one animal as ten-to-one chance

indicators.note: letters taken by chance fall into a random order

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral ten

explanation.surface: Betting odds of ten to one on a farm beast.
explanation.definitionFit: Oxen is the plural of ox, a farm animal.

clue.text: Timeless impasses cover the road to good wishes

indicators.note: the outer word covers the inner, so the road sits inside
less the T for time, so that letter is removed

parts.note: stymies are blocked positions in golf, impasses
a path is a road or way

explanation.surface: Endless deadlocks over the roadway lead to messages of goodwill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Timeless' drops the T, and 'cover' wraps what remains of the golfing word round PATH. A stymie was a golf position where an opponent's ball blocked the hole.
explanation.definitionFit: Sympathies are expressions of fellow feeling and good will.

clue.text: Transport from gold to bay

parts.note: AU is the chemical symbol for gold
taken as written
Mobile Bay is in Alabama

explanation.surface: Moving goods from a gold mine to the coast.
explanation.walkthrough: MOBILE is the Alabama city on Mobile Bay.
explanation.definitionFit: A car is a means of transport.

clue.text: Having catkins gives one bananas

parts.note: a means one
bananas and mental both mean crazy

explanation.surface: Someone driven crazy by a catkin-bearing tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Amental is a botanical term for bearing catkins, called aments.

clue.text: Second person to apply electronic restraint to reel?

parts.note: a tagger fits an offender with an electronic tag

explanation.surface: A prison officer fitting an ankle tag, wobbly on his feet.
explanation.definitionFit: To reel is to sway unsteadily, to stagger.

clue.text: Sentimental individual leaving Sikh city disturbed

indicators.note: disturbed letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: I, one, an individual

explanation.surface: A lone figure fleeing a troubled Sikh city in an emotional story.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of SIKH CITY, once the I of 'individual leaving' goes, are rearranged by 'disturbed'.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitschy describes art that is sentimental and in poor taste.

clue.text: An arrest appropriate for one's mega heresy

parts.note: an is the article a
to nab is to arrest
apt means appropriate
I's, one is
M is the symbol for mega, a million

explanation.surface: A fitting arrest for one great heretic.
explanation.definitionFit: Anabaptism, rebaptising adults, was branded a heresy in the Reformation.

clue.text: Somewhat unconvincing appeal for love?

parts.note: SOS is a distress call, an appeal
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A half-hearted plea for affection.
explanation.definitionFit: So-so means mediocre, only middling, not really convincing.

clue.text: Notes of sums to be paid on horses may be connected with lengthy answers

definitions.text: may be connected with lengthy answers

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the notes follow the horses

parts.note: a stud is a set of horses kept for breeding

parts.words: Notes of sums to be paid
parts.note: IOUs are notes promising to pay a debt

explanation.surface: Betting slips on horses, linked to long answers.
explanation.definitionFit: A studious pupil, devoted to study, may write long exam answers.

clue.text: Goatherd's comment on unpleasant surprise?

indicators.note: the 's means the herdsman's word has these letters within it

explanation.surface: A goatherd swearing at a nasty shock.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe s reads as has: the herdsman's name has the answer inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An oath is a curse or swearword, the sort of remark blurted out at a shock.

clue.text: Auxiliaries do what they are supposed to do

definitions.text: do what they are supposed to do

parts.note: be is an auxiliary verb
have is another auxiliary verb

explanation.surface: Helpers who do just what's expected of them.
explanation.definitionFit: To behave is to act properly, as one is supposed to.

clue.text: Secret business on green

indicators.note: on means placed after in this across clue

parts.note: Co. is the abbreviation for company, a business
vert is green in heraldry

explanation.surface: A clandestine company deal on the village green.
explanation.definitionFit: Covert means hidden or secret.

clue.text: Break down to earth in an insincere way

parts.note: hol is short for holiday, a break
lowly means humble, down to earth

explanation.surface: Taking a holiday at ground level, without meaning it.
explanation.definitionFit: Hollowly means emptily, without sincerity.
